Jamal: Heads-up: authz attribution is wrong for some SA exchanges. Usage showing under router service instead of customer project. Anyone else see this?
Maria: Yep, saw quota blips on router nodes at 02:10 UTC.
Sophie: Might be our claim normalization in auth-proxy. We compress headers; maybe origin dropped.
Raoul: We do rewrite `x-effective-identity` to the proxy principal during exchange. Billing currently trusts that header.
Linh: Repro: client -> edge-proxy(exchange) -> router -> inference. After exchange `x-origin-org` missing, `x-effective-identity` is `service/router@redwood`.
Jamal: Attribution prefers `x-effective-identity` over `x-origin-org`. Need a decision on precedence.
Maria: Short-term: fallback to `x-origin-org` if `x-effective-identity` looks like infra principal (endswith `@redwood`).
Sophie: OK but watch internal customers. Better to have infra-principal list or signed proof.
Raoul: Mapping exists but stale. Long-term: add `x-origin-sig` from auth-service so proxy can forward signed provenance.
Linh: Minimal change: auth exchange returns `origin_sig`, proxy forwards as `x-origin-sig`.
Jamal: Short-term mitigation: ETL rule to prefer `x-origin-org` when `x-effective-identity` in infra list. Also mark suspected events to avoid billing credits.
Maria: Can do ETL rule and add a dashboard tile showing mismatches. Roll for 24h.
Sophie: I'll bump sampling to 100% for these paths for 6h and wire the dashboard.
Raoul: I'll file INFRA-4129 design doc for `origin_sig`.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: noted canary rollback for auth-proxy v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 (health-checks).
Linh: If we rollback we still need ETL rule.
Jamal: Actions: Sophie -> ETL + dashboard; Raoul -> infra ticket + doc; Maria/Linh -> sampling and paste traces.
Maria: Scheduling 15m sync in 30m.
Sophie: Will ping when dashboard PR ready.
Raoul: Ticket opened INFRA-4129 and linked.
Jamal: Thanks, want to avoid billing surprises.
Maria: :thumbsup:
